thread:
Lina V.: dropped a tiny figma for a 'clipboard' board in the trace viewer — https://figma.com/s/trace-clipboard
Lina V.: TL;DR: let users pin request cards while investigating errors. Board supports reorder, small notes, export (CSV/JSON) and copyable permalink. Want copy choices, discoverability, and a11y check.
Marcus R.: +1. Keep CTAs short: "Pin request" or just "Pin". Avoid jargon like 'session' in primary buttons. Use a small hint in the board header if we need to explain scope.
Eli W.: implementation: client-side localStorage first is fastest. Recommend 20 pin soft limit, show clear "Clear board". Server persistence later behind flag.
accessibility-bot: checklist: pin control must be keyboard focusable and use <button aria-pressed>. Board panel should be role="dialog" with focus trap and focus restore. Copy actions should announce via aria-live: "Permalink copied." Tooltips via aria-describedby.
Marcus R.: placement debate: header badge vs floating dock. Hybrid works: small badge in header showing count + collapsible dock when in trace view. Dock must be dismissible with ESC and not overlap important content on small widths.
Lina V.: agreed. For export modal: defaults JSON and CSV, add "Include spans & stacktrace" checkbox. Filenames: "redwood-trace-<shortid>.json". Also add progress UI for large exports.
Eli W.: will prototype client-only version behind feature flag and emit telemetry: pin.add, pin.remove, export.start, export.done, copy.permalink. Plan: 1 sprint for MVP limited to 5 traces per export.
Marcus R.: left a few micro-copy suggestions in figma. :thumbsup:
Lina V.: thanks — I'll update mock and post a demo GIF when ready.
